conversation.description: a thread with no other subject; doc holds the person's words and its first line as the title

inbox_new.title: Start a conversation
inbox_new.description: Create a conversation: conversation{} marks the thread and doc{title, body} holds the caller's words, with their first line as the title. Attributed to the caller. Returns the applied bundles; starts no session itself.

text.description: the words that start the conversation; the first line is its title

inbox_summary.description: Exact person inbox thread summaries, derived at read; history bodies are included only for an explicitly requested thread or server-side search.

actor.description: the person whose attention is read

text.description: text to find in said or received words

direction.description: said or received; empty for both

lane.description: one lane, or empty for every lane

thread.description: one thread requested in full, or empty for summaries

threads.description: exact ordered policy records with root/latest rows and lazy messages
